types.name: polyester.api.AuthenticationMethod
types.doc: AuthenticationMethod identifies a credential type accepted by an RPC.

values.name: SESSION_TOKEN
values.doc: A bearer token for an interactive user session.

values.name: BROKER_API_KEY
values.doc:
A broker API key, sent as a bearer token. A broker's members create it
 in the QuickSwap broker API; it is not an account API key.

types.name: polyester.api.MFARequirement
types.doc: MFARequirement describes the interactive MFA assurance documented for an RPC.

values.name: MFA_RECENT
values.doc: The RPC requires recently completed interactive MFA. Stale assurance must be renewed.

values.name: MFA_FRESH_STEP_UP
values.doc: The RPC always requires a fresh, single-use step-up proof, even when MFA was completed recently.

values.name: MFA_CONDITIONAL
values.doc: The required MFA level depends on the request.
